what_to_say: IPEDS reports race and ethnicity categories, not an underrepresented-minority group. Combining categories into such a group is planned for a later stage; the categories themselves can be shown now.

example_wording: "graduation rate for STEM majors"; "completion by program"
what_to_say: IPEDS reports graduation rates for each school's whole entering cohort and some subgroups (race, gender, Pell), not by major. Degrees awarded by field of study can be shown.
pointer: The institution's own records, or a state longitudinal data system

what_to_say: IPEDS does not record which high school students came from. It reports first-time students by state of residence, which can be shown.
pointer: State longitudinal data systems; National Student Clearinghouse

example_wording: "follow students from enrollment to graduation"; "connect SAT to graduation"
what_to_say: IPEDS holds totals for each school, not records of individual students, so it cannot link one student's enrollment, test scores and graduation. The app can show these as separate school-level figures.
pointer: The institution's own student records; National Student Clearinghouse; state longitudinal data systems
